pool.text: French battleship Saint Louis served in the French Navy until nineteen nineteen.
St. Louis All-Stars competed as a professional football team during this period.
St. Louis Gunners participated as a member of the National Football League.
German ocean liner MS St. Louis carried refugees during a notable voyage.
St. Louis Bombers operated as a defunct National Basketball Association team.
St. Louis Browns professional baseball team transitioned to become the Baltimore Orioles.
St. Louis Hawks played as a professional basketball team until nineteen sixty-eight.
St. Louis Cardinals operated in this capacity until nineteen eighty-seven.
St. Louis Steamers operated as a former indoor soccer team until nineteen eighty-eight.
St. Louis Ambush participated as an indoor soccer team until the year two thousand.
St. Louis Stampede played as members of the Arena Football League.
Saint-Louis-de-France, Quebec merged into Trois-Rivières during this year.
St. Louis Attack operated as a professional indoor football team until two thousand fifteen.
